activities.name: The Blue Lagoon, Comino
activities.note: the crowding is as seasonal as the water: between 10:00 and 15:00 in high summer the ferries land in numbers, so early or after 16:00 is a different place

windows.reason: warm water without the peak-season crowds — autumn is the pick, with the sea still at 24–26 °C
the busiest weeks of the year on a very small island

activities.name: Sea swimming
activities.note: Malta holds a sea above 20 °C for six months of the year, a longer window than almost anywhere else in the Mediterranean

windows.reason: the sea stays above 20 °C from June to November, peaking at 25–26 °C in September and holding 23–24 °C through October
the tail of the swimming season
